/* v1.3.26 date-first public bookings */
.booking-date-browser{padding-bottom:110px}.booking-date-grid{display:grid;gap:10px}.booking-date-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) 28px;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow);text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.booking-datebox.large{height:70px}.booking-date-copy{display:grid;gap:4px;min-width:0}.booking-date-copy b{font-size:15px}.booking-date-copy small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.booking-date-arrow{font-size:30px;color:var(--muted);text-align:right}.selected-booking-date{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}.selected-booking-date h2{margin:3px 0 0}.booked-slot-list{display:grid;gap:10px}.booked-slot-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.booked-slot-time{display:grid;gap:1px}.booked-slot-time b{font-size:14px}.booked-slot-time span{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}.booked-slot-copy{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}.booked-slot-copy>b{font-size:14px}.booked-slot-copy small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.booking-request-date{margin-top:14px}.center{text-align:center}@media(max-width:420px){.booking-date-card{grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr) 22px;gap:10px;padding:10px}.booked-slot-card{grid-template-columns:82px minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px}.booked-slot-card>.pill{grid-column:2;justify-self:start}.booking-datebox.large{height:62px}}
